name: Multiplication
description: Learn to make equal groups, read them as arrays, and work facts out from facts you already know.
author: Koda Math Lab
tagline: Equal groups, arrays, and facts you can work out.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads prompts, counts aloud as groups are filled and hops are made, speaks hints, and says why a move was refused. Uses AI-generated voice recordings. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays placement, counting and answer chimes.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration to placing an object, hopping along the line, and finishing a group.

features.name: 1-to-1 badges
features.description: Numbers what has been counted so far — the objects inside each group, the squares of an array, and the landings along a number line.

features.name: Running total
features.description: Shows how many there are so far as groups are built, arrays grow, and hops are made.

features.name: Strategy scaffold
features.description: Shows the working as it is built: the repeated addition, the shape being aimed for, and the multiplication a run of hops is writing.

features.name: Times table chart
features.description: Adds a button to fact lessons that shows a full times table to look facts up in. Never offered during practice.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels warm-up, guided, activity, and milestone steps.

features.name: Charge for later lessons
features.description: Uses the Free lessons setting to decide which lessons need a full plan.
